headline: United won the first half on xG (1.10 to 0.28), then lost the second 2.39 to 0.08 after Chelsea's 50th-minute opener and Lisandro Martinez's 63rd-minute red card.

team_story.label: First-half xG
team_story.why_it_matters: United created far more than Chelsea before the break and still went in goalless (shot-map sums, ESPN).
team_story.source: data/matches/manchester-united-chelsea-2026-10-31/derived.json (analysis.py) from shots_espn.json; ESPN match page https://www.espn.co.uk/football/match/_/gameId/401879248/manchester-united-chelsea, Shots section

team_story.label: Second-half xG
team_story.why_it_matters: The match flipped completely after the break: United had 3 shots, Chelsea 11. Chelsea's number includes the penalty (0.79 xG, ESPN shot 19).
team_story.source: derived.json from shots_espn.json plus ESPN shot 19 (C. Palmer 64' Penalty 0.79 xG), https://www.espn.co.uk/football/match/_/gameId/401879248/manchester-united-chelsea

team_story.label: Shots on target
team_story.why_it_matters: Chelsea hit the target almost twice as often over 90 minutes.

team_story.label: Touches in opposition box
team_story.source: https://www.espn.com/soccer/team-stats/_/gameId/401879248, Attack section; BBC Match Stats https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/live/c6z7xglw0ewzt (40 v 21)

tactical_change.after: 10 men after Lisandro Martinez's second yellow (formation listed as 4-2-3-1 for both teams, no shape change)
tactical_change.trigger: Chelsea scored in the 50th minute, then Martinez was sent off in the 63rd for a second yellow and Palmer scored the resulting penalty in the 64th
tactical_change.effect: The second-half shift: United's xG fell from 1.10 in the first half to 0.08 in the second, Chelsea's rose from 0.28 to 2.39.

evidence.label: Chelsea xG, 1st half vs 2nd half
evidence.source: derived.json (analysis.py) from shots_espn.json plus ESPN shot 19 penalty 0.79

best_player.name: Morgan Rogers
best_player.why: Scored the opener in the 50th minute from his one shot (0.65 xG) and topped the BBC fan ratings.
best_player.source: https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/live/c6z7xglw0ewzt, Player of the match + Chelsea ratings (7.90); ESPN shot 17 (xG 0.65) https://www.espn.co.uk/football/match/_/gameId/401879248/manchester-united-chelsea

worst_player.name: Lisandro Martinez
worst_player.why: Sent off in the 63rd minute for a second yellow; the VAR penalty was scored by Palmer in the 64th. Lowest BBC fan rating of any player in either team.
worst_player.source: https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/live/c6z7xglw0ewzt, Manchester United ratings (2.23), lineups (L. Martinez 63' Two Yellow Cards) and report; ESPN header (Cole Palmer 64' Pen) and shot 19 (0.79 xG)

surprise_stat.label: United's first-half xG against Chelsea's
surprise_stat.context: United created nearly four times Chelsea's first-half xG and trailed 0-0 only at the break; they lost 2-0.

caveats: No official player ratings exist; the only per-player ratings are BBC Sport fan (user) averages. Labelled 'BBC fan rating' everywhere.

Half and phase xG are sums of ESPN shot-map values; ESPN shot 19 (Palmer penalty, 0.79 xG) is missing from the parsed shots_espn.json and added by hand in analysis.py (Chelsea total 2.67 = BBC xG 2.6687). United's shot-map sum is 1.18, BBC xG says 1.1654: the reel uses only half-by-half figures, not whole-match xG.
shots_espn.json 'outcome' labels are unreliable (offset in the page parse), so no shot outcome figures are used.
Both teams are listed as 4-2-3-1, so there was no formation change; the story is the second-half shift around the red card.
BBC league table snapshot shows United 18th while the BBC report says 16th: no league position is used.
Disallowed goals: Cunha (first half) and Estevao (71') were ruled out for offside per BBC report and Guardian live blog; not used with numbers.
